desc: While holding or wearing this talisman, you have Advantage on any [[/skill arc]]  check you make to control a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgSphereOfAnnih]{Sphere of Annihilation}. In addition, when you start your turn in control of a Sphere of Annihilation, you can take a Magic action to move it 10 feet plus a number of additional feet equal to 10 times your Intelligence modifier. This movement doesn't have to be in a straight line.
name: talisman of the sphere
